1: // Canvas Escape – minimal endless‑runner
2: // Canvas element with id "game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // ----- player -----
12:   const player = {
13:     x: width * 0.2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     radius: 12,
16:     speedX: 0,
17:     speedY: 0,
18:     maxSpeed: 4,
19:     update() {
20:       this.x += this.speedX;
21:       this.y += this.speedY;
22:       // keep inside bounds (lose condition if out)
23:       if (this.x < 0 || this.x > width || this.y < 0 || this.y > height) this.alive = false;
24:     },
25:     draw() {
26:       ctx.beginPath();
27:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
28:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd57';
29:       ctx.fill();
30:     },
31:     alive: true,
32:   };
33: 
34:   // ----- input handling -----
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
38: 
39:   function handleInput() {
40:     player.speedX = 0; player.speedY = 0;
41:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.speedY = -player.maxSpeed;
42:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.speedY = player.maxSpeed;
43:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.speedX = -player.maxSpeed;
44:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.speedX = player.maxSpeed;
45:   }
46: 
47:   // ----- obstacles -----
48:   class Obstacle {
49:     constructor() {
50:       this.x = width + 40; // start off‑screen
51:       this.y = Math.random() * height;
52:       this.width = 80; // length of bar
53:       this.height = 20; // thickness of bar
54:       this.gap = 80; // size of gap in the bar
55:       this.angle = 0; // rotation angle in radians
56:       this.speed = 2; // horizontal speed
57:       // random rotation direction
58:       this.rotSpeed = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (Math.PI / 180) * (1 + Math.random() * 2);
59:     }
60:     update() {
61:       this.x -= this.speed;
62:       this.angle += this.rotSpeed;
63:     }
64:     draw() {
65:       ctx.save();
66:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
67:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
68:       ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
69:       // draw two rectangles leaving a gap in the middle
70:       // top part
71:       ctx.fillRect(-this.width / 2, -this.height / 2 - this.gap / 2, this.width, this.height);
72:       // bottom part
73:       ctx.fillRect(-this.width / 2, this.gap / 2, this.width, this.height);
74:       ctx.restore();
75:     }
76:     // simple circle‑rectangle collision using separating axis theorem approximation
77:     collides(circle) {
78:       // approximate by checking distance from obstacle center line
79:       const dx = circle.x - this.x;
80:       const dy = circle.y - this.y;
81:       // rotate point opposite to obstacle rotation
82:       const cos = Math.cos(-this.angle);
83:       const sin = Math.sin(-this.angle);
84:       const rx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
85:       const ry = dx * sin + dy * cos;
86:       // check against two axis‑aligned rectangles
87:       const halfW = this.width / 2;
88:       const halfH = this.height / 2;
89:       const gapHalf = this.gap / 2;
90:       const inTop = ry > -halfH - circle.radius && ry < -gapHalf && rx > -halfW && rx < halfW;
91:       const inBottom = ry > gapHalf && ry < halfH + circle.radius && rx > -halfW && rx < halfW;
92:       return inTop || inBottom;
93:     }
94:     offscreen() { return this.x + this.width < 0; }
95:   }
96: 
97:   const obstacles = [];
98:   let frame = 0;
99:   let score = 0;
100: 
101:   function spawnObstacle() {
102:     obstacles.push(new Obstacle());
103:   }
104: 
105:   function update() {
106:     if (!player.alive) return;
107:     handleInput();
108:     player.update();
109:     // obstacles
110:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.update());
111:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
112:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].offscreen()) obstacles.shift();
113:     // collision
114:     for (const o of obstacles) {
115:       if (o.collides(player)) { player.alive = false; break; }
116:     }
117:     // score – increase per frame
118:     score++;
119:     // spawn new obstacles every 120 frames (~2 sec at 60fps)
120:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
121:     frame++;
122:   }
123: 
124:   function draw() {
125:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
126:     // background
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
129:     // obstacles
130:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.draw());
131:     // player
132:     if (player.alive) player.draw();
133:     // score
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
135:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
136:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
137:     if (!player.alive) {
138:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
139:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
140:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
141:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
142:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
143:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
144:     }
145:   }
146: 
147:   function loop() {
148:     update();
149:     draw();
150:     if (player.alive) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151:   }
152: 
153:   // start
154:   spawnObstacle();
155:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156: })();

(End of file - total 156 lines)
</content>
